rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The government's answer of 23 May 2000 states that at 09:00 on 3 April 2000 Chief Cabinet Secretary 青木, considering that Prime Minister Obuchi remained in intensive care, actually began performing the duties of acting prime minister (実際に臨時代理としての職務を開始).

locator.speaker: 松谷蒼一郎 (内閣官房副長官)
locator.part: paragraph beginning 翌三日午前九時の時点において

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same answer states that at the 12:40 extraordinary cabinet meeting on 3 April 2000 青木 reported the Prime Minister's condition, the acting designation and the start of his acting duties, and that notice of the acting designation (臨時代理の発令通知) was sent to the Speakers of both Houses and the Official Gazette procedure taken.

locator.part: paragraph beginning その後、同日午後零時四十分に臨時閣議を開催し

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same answer states that the cabinet, judging on 4 April 2000 that Prime Minister Obuchi (小渕総理) being unconscious with no near prospect of recovery fell under art. 70's 'lacking' case, decided on resignation en masse at the 19:00 extraordinary cabinet meeting that day.

locator.part: paragraph beginning 内閣総辞職につきましては

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-12 only. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this role in this packet: an unnamed statement, agenda or ceremony record, an acting prime minister, the House of Councillors' 1998 designee or the successor at the closing boundary. Ministers, deputy prime ministers and party offices are excluded.
